name: Garnier Hair food Shampoo Aloe vera
description:
Garnier Fructis Hair Food Aloe Vera Shampoo 350ml is a hydrating shampoo carefully formulated to address the needs of dehydrated hair. By incorporating the natural benefits of aloe vera, this shampoo focuses on replenishing and locking in moisture, helping strands feel refreshed and smooth. Its formulation is designed to leave hair soft and manageable, ensuring that it does not become heavy or weighed down after use. Ideal for hair that ranges from normal to dry, this shampoo offers lasting hydration, as the inclusion of aloe vera, alongside vitamins C, E, and F, contributes to hydrated and soft hair. In fact, the formula offers eight times more hydration to the hair.

Furthermore, this shampoo is made with vegan ingredients and contains 95% naturally derived components. It is also 98% biodegradable and is free from silicones. In summary, this shampoo focuses on delivering hydration and softness to the hair, being ideal for revitalizing dehydrated hair. In short, it stands as a great choice for those in need of restoring optimal hydration to the hair.
